name: Cable TV
description: Builds cable-style channels from your libraries, collections, playlists, genres and decades on a deterministic schedule, publishes them to Live TV with a guide, and exposes a schedule API for clients that tune in instantly by direct-playing at the right offset.
overview: Scheduled, always-on channels built from your library

versions.changelog: Project moved to github.com/franticg33k/jellyfin-cable-tv. Includes 0.3.0.0: time slots, restricted hours, seasonal lineups, premieres, form-based settings, guide refresh after server start.
